KuCoin announced it will delist all Monero (XMR) spot trading pairs on November 30. XMR deposits have been permanently disabled, while withdrawals are scheduled to close on December 31. KuCoin will also discontinue XMR savings, conversion and spot trading bot services. Binance and OKX previously delisted XMR in 2024, while Kraken has discontinued XMR trading for users in several jurisdictions, including the EEA, Canada and India. — link
